messages:
anya: ap-southeast-2 GPU nodes failing to finish init since 04:22 UTC. autoscaler backlog + jobs queueing.
mike: seeing `KMS AccessDenied` and `connection reset` in init logs, likely egress deny from the new fw template delta. Ill roll it back.
sre-bot: detected policy apply: fw-change-privilege-lockdown by mike at 2026-07-19T04:19:33Z.
anya: tcpdump shows RSTs to kms.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com ranges. nodes can't get bootstrap token.
mike: rollback applied. adding ephemeral SG allow for KMS+STS with 20m TTL to speed rejoin.
security-bot: Logged SEC-2026-412. Short-term allow ok, recommend KMS Privatelink/VPC endpoint and a fw-change canary test.
anya: After patch init logs show decrypt success and node join:
```
2026-07-19T04:27:11Z init: sts:AssumeRole -> 200 OK
2026-07-19T04:27:12Z init: KMS Decrypt -> 200 OK
2026-07-19T04:27:37Z join: node registered to pool-gpu-ase2a
```
finance: cost hit estimate while failing over to us-east-1 warm pools ~ $3.1k/hr. tagging finance for recovery review.
mike: follow-ups: 1) open Privatelink request for KMS+STS in ap-southeast-2 2) add KMS decrypt smoke test to fw pipeline 3) require ephemeral allow TTL <= 30m and auto-audit ticket creation 4) add fw-template CI lint to validate required service ranges.
anya: opening INC-2026-499, attaching logs and tcpdumps. will write the postmortem checklist and playbook snippet.
security-bot: scheduling design review for Privatelink next week; require IAM and fw owners to attend.
anya: thanks all. closing thread once INC-2026-499 has the postmortem link. :white_check_mark:
